decisions.reason: It fits closely with the firm's compliance-focused hosting know-how, has at least an early positive agency-oriented signal, and the firm's own R&D should let it learn from initial use and improve the software.
As a direct extension of the firm's core hosting and management capabilities, this platform strongly matches existing knowledge and infrastructure, making it a natural product to retain and refine.

This managed hosting plan is very close to the established offer, uses the firm's existing technical and service capabilities efficiently, and can be iterated through customer feedback with low knowledge distance.
